test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following dance forms is correctly matched with the state to which it is associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gaur - Chhattisgarh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gaur Maria dance **is performed on the **plateau **of **Bastar in Chhattisgarh**.
 
• It is **performed **on the **occasion of marriage **and is believed that it is **performed **with **more joy **than other dances.
 
• **Gaur dance **is a **popular folk dance **of **Madhya Pradesh dances**.
 
• **Gaur dance **is popular in the **Sing Marias **or **Tallaguda Marias **of **South Bastar**.
 
• **Men put headdresses **with **stringed 'cowries**' and **plumes of peacock feathers **and **make their way **to the **dancing ground**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raas **or **Dandiya Raas **is the **socio-religious folk dance **originating from the Indian state of **Gujarat **and popularly performed during the **festival of Navaratri**. The dance is **performed **in the **Marwar region **of **Rajasthan too**. 
 
• **Lavani **is a genre of **music popular **in **Maharashtra, India**. **Lavani **is a **combination **of **traditional song **and **dance**, which is particularly performed to the **beats of Dholki**, a percussion instrument.
 
• **Ghoomar **or **ghumar **is a **traditional folk dance **of **Rajasthan**. It was the **Bhil tribe **who performed it to **worship Goddess Sarasvati **which was later **embraced **by other **Rajasthani communities**. The dance is **chiefly performed **by **veiled women **who wear **flowing dresses called Ghaghara.**
